SUBSTATIONS | Technical Procedure
Introduction
The first draft initiated by: eng. Saleh Abdou, tested by eng 
 Mohamed Abaas & eng Tawfeek Ramadan, revised by quality control eng. 
 Tawfeek Elabasery at EDEPCo., accepted by general manager eng Tarek yosife 
 Ali and approved by eng Mechaeal Gorge Habashy head sector of Ayoun Moussa 
 power station
This procedure 
 details the major maintenance activities (2nd level of 
 maintenance as indicated by the P2), which are performed from 2:3 years as 
 indicated by the Y2:3 .
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
 suitable ID safety category,
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required,
Wear the appropriate 
 safety equipment as safety shoes, helmet,
Reactor out of service and work permit required.
Use 
 only fiberglass ladders.
If 
 it becomes necessary to enter the main tank, be sure that the oxygen level is 
 sufficient to provide safe working conditions.
Personnel carrying out the inspection should be trained and qualified or 
 directly supervised by someone who is.
Tools and Equipment
1. 
 Mugger 2000 volt.
2. 
 Binoculars or infrared scope.
3. 
All tools needed to complete the work
Work to be carried out
1- 
 Insulating oil (dielectric strength)
Using an oil tester, make a dielectric strength measurement of the insulating 
 oil in the main tank .
2- Insulation of Windings
1. 
 Measurement of winding insulation 
 resistance.
2. 
 Measurement of dielectric loss 
 factor (tan δ) 
 of winding.
3. 
 Inspections by other insulation judging methods.
3- Insulating oil
1. 
 Measurement of dielectric strength.
2. 
 Measurement of neutralization number.
3. Measurement of water content.
4. Gas analysis .
4- Oil preservation system
1. 
 Check oil level and for proper 
 relation with oil temperature.
2. 
 Check for oil leaks.
3. 
 Check that the oil stop valve 
 between tank and conservator is open.
4. 
 Refer to separate instructions, if 
 any
5- 
 No-voltage Tap changer (if provided)
1. 
 Check for oil leaks.
2. 
 Checks tap position.
3. 
 Check that bolts are tight
6- Fan motor
1. 
 Check the bearings for unusual sound and Vibration.
2. 
 Check the oil seals for unseal sound and Vibration.
7- Breather
1. 
 Check the breather.
2. 
 Check the oil level .
8- Bushing 
 (Porcelain type)
1. 
 Measurement of insulation resistance.
2. 
 Measurement of tand. 
 (If the bushing is of condenser type)
3. 
 Inspection of terminal and bushing top shield. Check for loose 
 connection or change in color.
4. 
 Check for contamination and damage of porcelain.
5. 
 Check for oil leaks.
6. 
 Check oil level, if provided.
9- Cooling 
 equipment.
1. 
 Clean the heat exchanger surface.
2. 
 Check for oil leaks and rust.
10- Indicator 
 (winding temperature ,Oil temperature) and protective Relays
1. 
 Check normal indication and 
 operation.
2. 
 Check the auxiliary wiring and the 
 signaling for the indicator and protective relays.
3. 
 Check for looseness of terminals and 
 lead
11- Tank
1. 
 Check for oil leaks.
2. 
 Inspection of finished surfaces. See 
 if rainwater gets collected on the tank top and causes rusting on edges and 
 corners .
12- Pressure 
 Relief Device
1. 
 Inspection of pressure relief plate, 
 if provided.
2. 
 Inspection of alarm contacts, if 
 provided.
3. 
 Check for oil leaks.
4. 
 Check for insulation resistance.
5. 
 Refer to separate instructions .
13- Buchholez 
 Relay
1. 
 Check whether or not any gas found 
 in the relay.
2. 
 If any free gas is found in the 
 relay. Check the gas for decomposable gases such as hydrogen, methane, 
 ethane, acetylene, carbon mono oxide and so forth. As for gas analysis, refer 
 to item 1.6.
3. 
 Refer to separate instructions.
14- 
 Cooler control cubicle
Enclosure
1. 
 Check for loose bolts or bolts which 
 have fallen off .
2. 
 Check for rust .
Terminal Blocks
Check for 
 loose connection or change in color .
Molded case 
 circuit breaker (MCCB)
1. 
 Check for loose connection or 
 change in color.
2. 
 Check for crack of body.
3. 
 Check for breakers which have 
 tripped.
Contactors (Mgsw)
1. 
 Check for loose connection or change 
 in color.
2. 
 Check for damage to contacts.
3. 
 Check for crack of body.
4. 
 Check for loose connection or change 
 in color of coil.
Thermal 
 relay
1. 
 Check for loose connection.
2. 
 Check for damage to heat element 
 device
Enclosed fuse (EF)
1. 
 Check for loose connection or change 
 in color.
2. 
 Check for crack of tube

2.

4.
